title: FULL-TIME PODCAST PRODUCTION ASSISTANT & VIDEO EDITOR
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person to join our podcast and media production team full-time.



You will help turn interviews into professional video clips, support podcast publishing, and keep our production workflow organized.



You will initially work on:

• The Amazing Authorities Podcast

• Booked For TV

• Client interviews featuring CEOs, authors, speakers, consultants, and experts



You will work with Mitch Carson, an author, international speaker, TV host, and podcast coach, alongside our production team.



We can teach our tools and processes. What you must bring is excellent English, a constructive attitude, reliability, and a keen eye for detail.



WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?



• Full-time work with an established podcast and media team.

• Daytime working hours in the Philippines.

• Paid onboarding and training in our production workflow.

• Clear instructions, branding examples, templates, and checklists.

• Regular team communication and support.

• An increase from $3 to $4 per hour after successfully completing the first 30 days.

• Opportunities to develop new skills and take on greater responsibility.



This is not an advanced animation or cinematic-editing position. Our priority is accurate, polished content and dependable production support.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALITIES



Excellent spoken and written English

Clear communication is essential. Correct spelling, punctuation, and grammar matter in every message, caption, description, and other communication with our team and clients.



A positive, solution-focused attitude

We want someone who approaches challenges by asking what can be done and suggesting practical next steps. Questions, honest feedback, and early reporting of problems are welcome. We expect respectful communication without gossip, blame, or unnecessary conflict.



A keen eye for detail

You should notice caption mistakes, misspelled names, incorrect branding, awkward framing, missing information, and disorganized files. Check your work before submitting it.



Reliability and accountability

Be punctual, attend scheduled calls, meet deadlines, and communicate promptly. If you encounter a problem, tell us early.



Willingness to learn

Follow instructions, ask when something is unclear, accept feedback professionally, and apply what you learn to future assignments.



Good organization

Keep files easy to locate, follow naming conventions, maintain accurate task updates, and use production checklists.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE — HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED



Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• CapCut and/or OpusClip.

• Canva video editing and basic branded graphics.

• Spotify for Creators, formerly Spotify for Podcasters or Anchor.

• Riverside.

• Podcast publishing and production support.

• Caption correction and short-form video editing.

• YouTube uploads and scheduling.

• Google Drive, Google Sheets, or similar organizational tools.



Other production skills can be taught. Applicants with excellent English, strong attention to detail, and the right attitude are encouraged to apply even if they have not used every tool.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Video editing and clip creation:

• Upload complete interviews into OpusClip.

• Review suggested clips and select compelling moments.

• Create approximately three vertical shorts per assigned interview.

• Polish clips in CapCut using our workflow.

• Correct caption spelling, punctuation, grammar, names, and technical terms.

• Frame speakers correctly for vertical video.

• Remove unnecessary pauses and improve weak openings without changing the speaker’s meaning.

• Apply approved logos, fonts, colors, and closing screens.

• Create basic 3–5-minute highlight videos when requested.

• Watch completed videos and check them before submission.



Podcast production support:

• Help set up and manage company- or client-owned Spotify for Creators accounts and shows.

• Upload and schedule approved episodes.

• Add approved titles, descriptions, artwork, guest details, and links.

• Learn our podcast hosting and distribution procedures.

• Check published episodes and links for accuracy.

• Assist with Riverside recordings and production files as trained.

• Flag missing information, incomplete uploads, or publishing problems.

• Follow our approval process before publishing content.



Organization and teamwork:

• Follow our file-naming and folder system.

• Organize recordings, project files, and final exports.

• Keep the production tracker updated.

• Maintain clear handoff notes and task status.

• Attend daily Zoom video calls with the team.

• Make requested corrections and apply feedback.

• Communicate professionally with team members and clients as assigned.



OUR EDITING STYLE



Our audience includes business owners, authors, executives, and professional experts. Videos should feel polished, credible, and engaging.



We prefer:

• A strong opening within the first three seconds.

• Clean, readable, accurate captions.

• Natural pacing and clear storytelling.

• Tasteful zooms and reframing.

• Selective emphasis of important words.

• Consistent branding.

• Appropriate closing screens and calls to action.



Avoid excessive emojis, distracting transitions, unnecessary sound effects, and frantic editing.



Every clip should make sense on its own and accurately represent what the guest said.



REQUIRED EQUIPMENT AND WORK ENVIRONMENT



You must have:

• Reliable internet service suitable for daily Zoom video calls and large video uploads and downloads.

• A newer-model laptop or desktop capable of running our editing tools and handling long podcast recordings reliably.

• A working webcam and a clear microphone or headset.

• A quiet work environment where you can concentrate and participate in daily team video calls without frequent interruptions.

• A practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



Please include your computer specifications and internet speeds in your application.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Working days: Monday–Friday.

• Working hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Philippine time.

• Lunch break: One hour unpaid.

• Paid working hours: 40 hours per week.

• First 30 days: $3 USD per hour.

• After successful completion of the first 30 days: $4 USD per hour.

• Payments: According to an agreed schedule.

• Assigned onboarding, training, production work, and requested revisions are paid.



The increase to $4 per hour depends on:

• Reliable attendance and punctuality.

• Clear, prompt communication.

• Meeting deadlines.

• Accurate captions and written work.

• Correct branding.

• Proper file organization.

• Following instructions.

• Demonstrating progress and applying feedback.



You must be available and responsive during scheduled working hours. Please disclose any existing commitments that could interfere with this schedule.



TRAINING AND PRODUCTION EXPECTATIONS



We will provide onboarding, examples, and checklists.



Training may include:

• CapCut and OpusClip workflows.

• Selecting strong interview moments.

• Caption correction and branding.

• Spotify setup and publishing procedures.

• Riverside recording and file handling.

• Production tracking and quality checks.

• Client communication and approval procedures.



After training, our initial planning target for approximately three standard vertical shorts is 60–90 minutes, depending on the recording and editing required.



Highlight videos, account setup, episode publishing, and more involved assignments will have separate time allowances. Expectations will be refined using actual production results.



Accuracy, sound judgment, and consistent improvement matter.



PROFESSIONAL NOTICE AND HANDOVER



We expect respectful communication and professional conduct.



If you d
 to resign, please provide at least two weeks’ written notice before your final working day, except where an emergency makes this impractical.



During your notice period, you are expected to:

• Complete agreed priorities.

• Update the production tracker.

• Organize and hand over source files, editable projects, and completed videos.

• Document outstanding tasks and deadlines.

• Assist with an orderly transition of assigned responsibilities.



Company and client accounts must remain under their respective owners’ control.



PAID SKILLS TEST



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid test.



The test may include:

• Proofreading a short caption or episode description.

• Selecting a strong moment from an interview and explaining your choice.

• Creating one simple vertical clip, with instructions appropriate to your experience.

• Following a file-naming and organization checklist.



The test brief, expected work time, payment amount, and payment date will be agreed before you begin. You will have a 48-hour delivery window.



We will assess English accuracy, attention to detail, judgment, communication, and ability to follow instructions.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words:



AUTHORITY EDITOR



Please include:



A short introduction explaining why you are a good fit.



Your relevant experience, including any administrative, podcast, content, or editing work.



Your experience with CapCut, OpusClip, Canva, Spotify for Creators, and Riverside. Be honest about which tools you have not used.



Links to relevant work samples, if available. Explain what you personally did. Applicants without editing samples may still be considered.



Your computer’s make, model, approximate age, processor, RAM, and available storage.



Your internet download and upload speeds, along with your backup plan for interruptions.



Confirmation that you have a quiet workspace, webcam, and microphone or headset for daily Zoom calls.



Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Philippine time.



Your current work commitments and earliest available start date.



A brief example of a work problem you encountered, what you did, and the result.



Confirmation that you accept $3 per hour for the first 30 days and $4 per hour after successfully completing the introductory period.



Confirmation that you agree to provide at least two weeks’ written notice if you resign, except in an emergency.



Please write your application in your own words. We want to understand how you communicate.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in accurate work, contributes positively to the team, and wants to build a dependable, long-term working relationship.

Job Description

The Project Manager (PM) at Intelligent Technical Solutions (ITS) leads client-facing technology projects in a fast-paced Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. This role is responsible for managing multiple small-to-medium IT projects simultaneously including client onboarding, Microsoft 365 migrations, infrastructure refreshes, network upgrades, and cybersecurity deployments. 

The PM ensures all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with both client expectations and ITS’s service standards. Working closely with technical teams, account managers, and service delivery leaders, the PM drives clear communication, structured execution, and exceptional client experience from kickoff to handoff. 



Job Responsibilities

Project Ownership & Execution 

Plan, coordinate, and deliver IT projects for SMB clients such as server/cloud migrations, security stack deployments, and network infrastructure upgrades.

Manage multiple concurrent projects using ConnectWise Manage.

Define project scope, tasks, timelines, and resource assignments using ITS templates and standards.

Track and communicate project milestones, dependencies, and risks with clients and internal teams.

Ensure seamless handoff to Service Delivery or Support once projects are completed. 



Stakeholder Engagement 

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution, ensuring consistent communication and expectation management.

Partner with Account Managers, vCIOs, and Technical Leads to align project objectives with client needs.

Conduct kickoff, status, and closeout meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

Ensure partners and vendors are informed of relevant project milestones and deliverables. 



Team Leadership & Risk Management 

Coordinate efforts across engineering, procurement, and service delivery teams to maintain accountability and progress.

Identify, document, and mitigate risks before they impact schedule or quality.

Proactively manage change requests and ensure project documentation remains current.

Uphold ITS’s quality standards and process discipline across all project engagements. 



What Success Looks Like 

Projects delivered on schedule and within defined scope.

Clients express high satisfaction with project communication and outcomes.

Internal handoffs to Service Delivery occur smoothly and without rework.

Documentation is complete, standardized, and audit-ready.

Cross-departmental collaboration and visibility are consistently strong.



Job Qualifications

3+ years of project management experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or IT consulting firm.

Proven success managing multiple concurrent client projects of varying scope and complexity.

Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies (especially Microsoft 365 and Azure), and cybersecurity best practices.

Project Closure Rate: Percentage of projects completed on time and within scope.

title: REO Portal Virtual Assistant Equator Pyramid RESNET Cascade
description:
We are a high volume real estate brokerage specializing in foreclosure, REO, and institutional listings. Our team works directly with asset managers, lenders, and government entities and operates in fast paced, compliance driven environment. Accuracy, consistency, and follow through are critical in this role. This is a long term opportunity for the right virtual assistant who wants stability, growth, and real responsibility in the REO space.



We are seeking an organized, detail driven Virtual Assistant to handle foreclosure and REO tasking across multiple client portals. Accuracy is crucial in this role. This position supports properties from assignment through closing and requires strong follow through, deadline management, and the ability to work independently within structured systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in portals, following task checklists, and maintaining compliance without constant oversight.



Primary responsibilities include completing all required tasks in REO and foreclosure portals, maintaining daily updates and status changes, monitoring deadlines and escalation requirements, and accurately uploading documents, photos, bids, and reports. You will be responsible for maintaining compliance across all client instructions and identifying missing or incorrect items before they become issues. Strong comprehension is needed in this position.



This role also includes coordinating with field staff and vendors, ordering inspections, occupancy checks, preservation services, and repair bids, and following up as needed. Inspections and bids must be reviewed for completeness and obvious discrepancies before submission. You will assist with BPO tasking and organization, including managing photos, comparable data, and required documentation.



Additional responsibilities include coordinating utility turn ons and shut offs, requesting HOA payoff statements and resale disclosures, assisting with title related items such as deeds, tax information, and lien data, supporting MLS data entry and updates when needed, and maintaining accurate internal records and tracking.



Prior experience with REO, foreclosure, or bank owned properties is required. Candidates must have hands on experience working inside REO client portals and a strong understanding of task based workflows, deadlines, and compliance requirements. Applicants should be prepared to list which portals they have worked in, how long they have handled REO or foreclosure files, and the types of tasks they managed on a daily basis.



Strong attention to detail, excellent written communication, and the ability to work independently are essential. This role requires someone who is organized, reliable, and comfortable with repetitive, accuracy driven work. Candidates must be able to troubleshoot issues as they arise and communicate clearly when escalation is needed.



Technical requirements include reliable high speed internet, a quiet home work environment, and proficiency with Google Workspace. Comfort using PDFs, spreadsheets, cloud storage, and task driven systems is required.



This is a full time position during Arizona, United States business hours. We offer a stable long term role with clear systems, structured training on our workflows and clients, and opportunities to grow into higher level REO coordination and oversight positions.



To apply, please include a brief summary of your REO or foreclosure experience, a list of portals you have worked in such as Equator, Pyramid, RESNET, Bid on Homes, or similar systems, and your availability to work United States business hours. Qualified candidates will be provided with a link to officially apply in our database.

Strong knowledge of U.S. real estate transactions, listings, documents and deadlines



Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy



Strong research and problem solving skills



Confident and professional on the phone



Ability to work independently without constant direction



Stable work history with previous employers



Reliable computer, internet and professional work environment



Dual monitors strongly preferred



REO EXPERIENCE WILL PUT YOU AT THE TOP OF OUR LIST.



If you have hands on experience with REO properties, foreclosure, default servicing, BPOs, property preservation, asset management, REO portals, utilities, title issues, liens, listing tasks or similar work, we absolutely want to hear from you.



A significant part of this position will involve REO tasking. These files can have dozens of client requirements, deadlines and moving pieces. The work must be completed correctly and on time. Accuracy is extremely important.



You will also assist with property research, utilities, title and lien information, listing documents, database management, email monitoring, vendor follow up, scheduling and phone communication with clients, vendors, title companies, utility providers and city or county offices.



We are looking for a problem solver. When you encounter something you do not know, we want your instinct to be to research it, develop a possible answer and then ask if you are on the right track.



We will teach you our REO processes. We do not have time to teach U.S. real estate from the beginning.

title: Junior Digital Marketing Designer – (Remote, PH)
description:
About the Role



Our Boardroom clients get huge value from our Founder's coaching calls and the SOPs that come out of them, but they don't yet have one place to log in and find it all. As our Junior Digital Marketing Designer, you'll build and own that training platform, so clients can easily find past lessons and put SOPs to work in their business.



You'll also own the LinkedIn optimisation pack for every new Boardroom client, from pulling details out of their onboarding call to delivering a polished, on-brand profile. On the side, you'll support our Digital Marketing Designer and Social Media Manager with design and content. You'll report to the Lead Generation Team Lead.



What You'll Do



Boardroom training platform



Build the platform from the ground up in Skool or a similar tool: structure, modules, lessons, welcome pages, and navigation

Organise recorded coaching calls into clear, easy-to-find lessons

Publish SOPs alongside the matching lesson so clients can go straight from watching to implementing

Design lesson thumbnails, module covers, and banners in line with brand guidelines

Keep the platform up to date and help new clients get access and get started



Boardroom client onboarding assets



Extract client details from their onboarding call with our Founder

Create a LinkedIn optimisation document for each client, including an optimised headline, About section, banner, and Featured section

Track what's been delivered to each client



Design support



Create carousels and other social graphics in Canva with the Social Media Manager

Support the Digital Marketing Designer with branded assets such as presentations and lead magnet guides



General



Collaborate with the team through Slack and HubSpot, reporting progress and meeting deadlines

Use AI tools like Claude to work more efficiently

Attend team meetings and give regular progress updates

What We're Looking For



Experience and skills



At least 2 years in graphic design, content creation, or digital marketing support (VA experience counts)

Proficiency in Canva: social graphics, carousels, banners, thumbnails, and presentations

Ability to follow brand guidelines and keep layouts consistent across many assets

Strong written English, including the ability to write a punchy headline and a clear About section

Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude) to summarise transcripts and draft copy, then editing so it sounds human

Basic video handling: uploading, organising, and making thumbnails for recorded calls

Working knowledge of Slack and HubSpot, and a platform like Captivation Hub or Go High Level, or a willingness to learn quickly

Highly organised, with clean file naming and folder structure



Nice to have



Experience building or managing an online course, membership, or community platform (Skool, Kajabi, Teachable, Thinkific, Circle)

Experience writing or optimising social media profiles or personal branding assets

Experience turning call recordings or transcripts into summaries, SOPs, or lesson notes



Education



Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Multimedia Arts, Communications, Graphic Design, or a related field

Candidates with a strong portfolio and relevant hands-on experience may be considered without a degree



Working style



Able to manage multiple workstreams (platform, client packs, design support) without dropping any

Excellent attention to detail, time management, and communication

Works well independently and with a remote team

Open to learning new tools, including AI

Our Values

Radical Transparency & Ownership: open, honest, and accountable

Constant Improvement: you spot ways to make things better and act on them

Over-Delivery: you go beyond the brief to ensure excellence

Courage: you give feedback and challenge ideas constructively

Work Setup Requirements

Laptop or desktop (Intel Core i7 or equivalent or higher, 8 GB RAM minimum with 16 GB preferred, 256 GB SSD or higher)

Stable internet of 30 Mbps or higher (for uploading call recordings) and a backup power source

Noise-cancelling headset and a high-quality webcam

Availability during AWST business hours

Willingness to follow Quantum's Work-from-Home Policy

What Success Looks Like

The Boardroom training platform is live and on brand, and clients actively log in to access lessons and SOPs

New coaching calls and SOPs go up without anyone needing to chase

Every new Boardroom client receives their LinkedIn optimisation pack on time

Materials are delivered on time and contribute to better content performance

Hiring Process

Application questions

Portfolio review (Canva or social design samples)

Short design test (60 to 90 minutes: a carousel post and an SOP landing page)

Initial interview

Culture fit interview with our CEO

How to Apply



Apply through [insert OLJ link] or send your resume and portfolio to 
 include Canva or social design samples in your portfolio.

title: Offer Onboarding Specialist – Digital Marketing Agency
description:
Pay: $1,500 AUD per month, increasing to $2,000 AUD per month once fully trained and consistently able to complete 25 calls per week

Type: Full-Time Contractor

Location: Remote

Work Hours: 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM Philippine Time

Industry: Digital Marketing / Meta Advertising

Role Type: Client-Facing / Onboarding / Marketing Strategy



Legacy Digital is looking for a confident, organised, and commercially minded Offer Onboarding Specialist to help prepare new clients for successful advertising campaigns.



This is not a basic admin or data-entry role.



You will be speaking directly with business owners on Zoom, reviewing their onboarding information, helping refine their marketing offer, confirming their target audience and creative direction, setting realistic advertising expectations, and making sure everything is ready before the campaign moves into production.



You do not need to be a Meta Ads media buyer, but you should understand basic digital marketing concepts and be comfortable discussing offers, leads, conversion rates, sales processes, and customer follow-up.



What You'll Be Doing



You will conduct structured 30-minute onboarding and offer creation calls with new clients.



Before every call, you'll review the client's onboarding form so you already understand approximately 80–90% of their business and campaign information.



Your job is to confirm and strengthen that information — not make the client repeat everything they have already submitted.



Your responsibilities will include:



Reviewing client onboarding forms before calls



Conducting client onboarding calls over Zoom



Confirming the client's primary advertising offer



Helping clients strengthen unclear or weak offers



Making sure each campaign has one clear offer and one clear outcome



Confirming the client's ideal customer and target market



Reviewing websites, social media pages and existing marketing



Discussing creative direction for advertising campaigns



Identifying available photos, videos and marketing assets



Reviewing competitor ads and creative inspiration



Setting realistic expectations around advertising performance



Explaining basic marketing metrics such as CPL, conversion rate, CPA/CAC, LTV and ROI



Reviewing how clients currently follow up with new leads



Identifying weaknesses in speed-to-lead and sales follow-up



Discussing SMS,
, appointment reminders and nurture systems



Introducing our CRM/automation solution when appropriate



Booking clients into additional strategy or CRM calls



Booking clients into our Agency Masterclass



Writing clear and accurate notes for our campaign production team



Ensuring the client's account is fully prepared before being passed to the build team



What A Successful Call Looks Like



At the end of each onboarding call, we should have:



One clear advertising offer



A confirmed target market



A clear creative direction



Realistic expectations around campaign performance



A documented lead follow-up process



Any missing information collected



The client booked into required follow-up calls



Complete notes for our campaign production team



The account ready to move into production



You'll Need To Be Comfortable Saying Things Like:



"Why should somebody take action on this offer today?"



"What outcome does your ideal customer actually want?"



"Based on your onboarding form, we're targeting this market. Does that still sound like your ideal customer?"



"Our goal during the first few weeks isn't perfection. We're gathering data, identifying what's working and optimising from there."



"If leads are coming in but aren't converting, we need to look at follow-up speed, lead qualification and the sales process."



You must be comfortable leading the conversation, not simply reading questions from a checklist.



We're Looking For Someone Who:



Has excellent spoken and written English



Is confident speaking with Australian, US, UK and other international clients



Is comfortable being on camera during Zoom calls



Can confidently lead conversations with business owners



Understands basic marketing and sales concepts



Can quickly understand different businesses and industries



Has good commercial judgement



Can recognise when an offer is unclear or difficult to market



Is comfortable making recommendations



Can explain marketing concepts in simple language



Is highly organised and detail-oriented



Takes accurate notes



Can follow an SOP without sounding robotic



Can think independently when something doesn't make sense



Is comfortable working with CRMs and online systems



Can professionally manage difficult or uncertain clients



Has reliable internet, computer equipment and a professional working environment



Strongly Preferred Experience



Experience in one or more of the following would be highly regarded:



Digital marketing agencies



Client onboarding



Account management



Customer success



Sales



Appointment setting



Marketing strategy



Meta/Facebook advertising



GoHighLevel



CRM systems



Lead generation



Offer creation



Sales funnels



Business consulting



You do not need to personally build or manage
 Ads, but you should understand how lead-generation campaigns work.



This Role Is NOT For You If:



You are uncomfortable speaking with clients on Zoom



You prefer roles where you can simply follow instructions without making decisions



You struggle to communicate confidently in English



You are afraid to challenge or clarify something a client says



You regularly join calls unprepared



You don't review information before meetings



You need a script for every possible situation



You struggle to understand basic sales or marketing concepts



You cannot maintain accurate client notes



You frequently miss appointments or deadlines



The Person We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who can become the bridge between our client and our advertising production team.



You should be able to speak with a business owner, quickly understand what they're selling, identify the strongest angle for the campaign, confirm who we're targeting, identify potential issues, and leave the call with a clear plan the production team can execute.



You should be friendly and approachable while still being confident enough to control the conversation.



Clients should leave the call feeling:



"These people understand my business and know exactly what we're doing next."



How To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.



Describe any experience you have conducting Zoom calls with clients.



Describe your experience with digital marketing, sales, lead generation or client onboarding.



What would you do if a client came to an onboarding call with an offer that you believed was too vague to advertise effectively?



A business owner receives 
 leads from
 Ads but 
't made any sales. What are the first things you would investigate?



Are you comfortable professionally challenging a client's idea if you believe it will negatively affect the campaign?



What CRM or marketing platforms have you used?



Please submit a 60–90 second video introduction explaining why you believe you would be good at this role.



Applications that do not include the requested information may not be considered.



Important: This is a client-facing position. Excellent English communication, confidence and reliability are essential.



Send Your Application



Send your application to 



 Subject: Offer Specialist - YOUR NAME

title: Part-Time Membership & Data Admin — US Trade Association (Texas Hours Overlap Required)
description:
Part-Time Membership & Data Admin — US Trade Association (Texas Hours Overlap Required)



We're looking for a warm, sharp, detail-obsessed admin to be the friendly voice of our membership team — and the keeper of our member data!



The Utility Contractors Association of Texas (UCATX) serves about 200 member companies across four chapters: North Texas, Austin, San Antonio, and Houston. Our members build and repair the water, sewer, and utility lines Texas runs on.



You'll check in with each member company by
. Each check-in shares what's coming up locally and statewide, confirms who at the company should receive our newsletter, and confirms who should receive their annual renewal invoice (and who should be cc'd). Your work d
 whether our December 1 renewal invoices land in the right inbox.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Send personalized check-in
s to member companies and manage the replies

- Confirm billing contacts, cc contacts, and any PO or vendor-setup needs before renewal invoices go out

- Keep newsletter recipient lists current: add new people, remove people who have moved on

- Update member records in our CRM (GlueUp) accurately, with every change logged

- Make short, scripted phone calls to US offices when
 doesn't get an answer

- Handle ongoing contact updates (about 5 a week)

- Send friendly payment reminders after invoices go out

- Starting in 2027: research prospective members and help onboard new ones



HOURS AND SCHEDULE



- About 20 hours a week through December, then about 8 to 12 hours a week ongoing

- At least 2 to 3 hours a day overlapping with 8 AM to 12 PM US Central Time (about 9 PM to 1 AM Manila time in October, 10 PM to 2 AM from November)

- Start date: no later than October 12



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Excellent written English and
 skills. You'll write to busy office managers and business owners. Your
s need to be clear, warm, professional, and short — the kind people actually answer.

- Comfortable making short, professional phone calls to US businesses

- Obsessive accuracy. One wrong
 address means a member never gets their invoice.

- Experience with a CRM or member database (GlueUp, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)

- Comfort with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive)

- Discretion with confidential business and contact information

- Reliable internet and a backup power plan



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with US clients, associations, nonprofits, or B2B companies



PAY



Tell us your expected hourly rate in USD. This starts as a trial through December, with plans to continue part-time into 2027.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "Forged" so we know you read this far! Then include:



- A short note on your CRM or data experience

- Your available hours in US Central Time

- Your expected hourly rate in USD

- A sample
 (under 150 words) to the office manager of a member company. It should share one upcoming event, ask whether two listed newsletter recipients are still correct, and ask who should receive their December 1 renewal invoice and whether anyone should be cc'd.

- A link to a 1-minute voice recording (Google Drive, Vocaroo, or similar) of you reading this phone script:



"Hi, this is [your name] with the Utility Contractors Association of Texas. ABC Pipeline is a member, and your renewal invoice goes out December 1. Who should receive that invoice, and is there anyone we should copy? Do you need a PO number or vendor setup to pay it?"



We can't wait to meet you!



Gratefully,



Mary Jane Debenport

Executive Director, Utility Contractors Association of Texas

description:
**Remote | One-on-One Training | Professional Voice Development**



I am looking for an **experienced professional voice training specialist / vocal coach** to work with me one-on-one through **Zoom**.



My goal is to improve my voice as much as realistically possible — including making it **clearer, stronger, more pleasant, better controlled, more confident, and more professional-sounding**.



This is **NOT simply a singing teacher position**. I am specifically looking for someone who understands the **voice itself** and can professionally assess and train an individual's voice.



## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



You should have strong professional knowledge and experience in areas such as:



* Vocal training and voice development

* **Vocal and throat anatomy**

* Breathing and breath support

* Vocal production

* Resonance

* Projection

* Pitch and pitch control

* Tone and vocal quality

* Articulation and clarity

* Vocal placement

* Voice strength and control

* Proper vocal technique

* Identifying weaknesses in a person's voice

* Creating exercises specifically for an individual's needs



You should be able to **listen carefully to my voice, identify what can be improved, explain what is happening, and create a structured training program to work on it.**



## ZOOM TRAINING



Training will primarily be done **one-on-one through Zoom**.



You should be comfortable demonstrating exercises remotely, listening carefully, correcting technique, and giving clear instructions that I can practice between sessions.



I am looking for someone who can develop a **personalized practice routine** rather than simply following a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT



I am looking for a **professional**, not someone who simply enjoys singing or has casual experience.



Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.



You should also be able to explain the *reason* behind the exercises you recommend.



## EXPERIENCE



Please tell me:



* How many years you have professionally trained voices

* What type of clients/students you normally work with

* Your professional qualifications or training

* Whether you specialize in singing, speaking voice, vocal development, or multiple areas

* Your experience conducting voice training through Zoom

* Any particularly difficult voice-development cases you have successfully worked with



## APPLICATION — PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RATE



**Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph.**



In your application, answer all of the following:



1. **Tell me about your professional voice-training experience.**

2. **How strong is your knowledge of vocal/throat anatomy?**

3. **What areas of the voice do you specialize in?**

4. **How would you approach improving someone's voice through Zoom?**

7. **Please provide your HOURLY RATE or SESSION RATE.**

8. **How long is one standard training session?**

9. **Do you offer a trial/first session? If so, what is the price?**



### IMPORTANT:



**You MUST state how much you charge in your application.**



Applications without a clear hourly or session rate may not be considered.



Please also provide a **website, profile, video, portfolio, or other evidence of your professional voice-training experience if available.**



I am looking for someone who is **professional, knowledgeable, patient, detail-oriented, and genuinely interested in helping me maximize the quality of my voice.**

title: 🧠 DEEP PERSONAL GROWTH & TRANSFORMATION SPECIALIST ### Looking for Someone Who Understands the Mind, Subconscious &
description:
### Looking for Someone Who Understands the Mind, Subconscious & Mind-Body Connection



**Remote | One-on-One | Zoom**



I am looking for an **excellent psychologist, therapist, mental-health coach, holistic life coach, or integrative wellness practitioner** who has deep knowledge of **personal transformation, subconscious patterns, emotional conditioning, behavior change, and mind-body approaches.**



I am currently healthy and am **not looking for treatment of a mental-health disorder or diagnosis.**



My goal is **personal growth and meaningful change**.



I want to become more motivated, improve how I represent myself, develop better habits and behaviors, overcome patterns that may be holding me back, and become the best version of myself.



## WHAT MAKES THIS POSITION DIFFERENT



I am looking for someone with a **deep and broad understanding of different approaches to personal transformation**, rather than someone who relies on only one standard therapeutic method.



For example, I am very interested in approaches such as:



* Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work

* Somatic and body-based approaches

* Inner-child work

* Hypnotherapy

* EFT / Tapping

* EMDR, when appropriately trained

* Meditation and mindfulness

* Breathwork

* Nervous-system regulation

* Subconscious and emotional-pattern work

* Visualization

* Mind-body approaches

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment and relational approaches

* Neuroplasticity and habit change

* Other experiential, integrative, holistic, or consciousness-based approaches



**These are examples, not a required checklist.**



If you know other powerful modalities or approaches that I have not mentioned, I want to hear about them.



In fact, discovering approaches I **don't already know about** is part of what I am looking for.



## 🧠 DEPTH OF KNOWLEDGE IS IMPORTANT



I want someone who understands the deeper relationship between:



**thoughts → emotions → nervous system → brain → subconscious/implicit patterns → behavior → habits → identity → change**



Knowledge of areas such as the **amygdala, subconscious processes, conditioning, neuroplasticity, habit formation, emotional learning, and behavior change** is a strong advantage.



I am also interested in the broader **mind-body and consciousness field**.



If you are familiar with **Dr. Joe Dispenza's work**, meditation approaches, visualization, emotional-state work, or similar mind-body/consciousness teachings, that is a major plus.



You do not need to follow any particular teacher or agree with every theory.



I am looking for someone who can **understand these ideas intelligently, explain them clearly, and distinguish established evidence from theories, interpretations, or spiritual concepts.**



## 🎯 I WANT AN ACTUAL PLAN



The biggest thing I am looking for is someone who can take all this knowledge and turn it into **practical personal development.**



I don't simply want to have conversations every week.



I want someone who can help me:



* Identify the areas I want to change

* Understand the patterns behind them

* Determine which approaches may be useful

* Create a personalized plan

* Give me specific exercises and practices

* Set realistic goals

* Create weekly action steps

* Follow up on my progress

* Hold me accountable

* Evaluate what is working and what isn't

* Adjust the approach when necessary

* Help me actually implement the changes



For example, if we identify a particular pattern or behavior I want to change, I want us to be able to say:



**What is the pattern?

What may be contributing to it?

What are we going to work on?

What technique or exercise will we use?

What am I going to practice this week?

What will we review next session?**



I want the work to be **structured, personalized, and results-oriented.**



## 🌱 THIS IS ABOUT GROWTH, NOT DIAGNOSIS



I want to emphasize that I am **currently healthy and seeking personal development**, not treatment for a psychiatric or medical condition.



I am looking for someone who can work with a healthy person who wants to:



* Grow personally

* Change behaviors and habits

* Improve motivation

* Build confidence

* Improve self-expression

* Understand themselves more deeply

* Develop greater awareness

* Become more consistent

* Improve their relationships and communication

* Break unwanted patterns

* Create meaningful positive change



If you are a licensed psychologist or therapist, please state your credentials.



If you are a coach or practitioner rather than a licensed mental-health professional, that is also fine — **please clearly explain your actual training, certifications, experience, and scope of practice.**



## 👤 WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is someone who has **studied multiple approaches and developed a broad professional toolbox.**



You might be:



* A psychologist with additional integrative training

* A therapist trained in multiple modalities

* An IFS or somatic practitioner

* A holistic/integrative therapist

* A highly trained life or wellness coach

* A hypnotherapist

* A mind-body practitioner

* A meditation or mindfulness professional

* Or another practitioner with substantial training in personal transformation



The specific title is less important to me than **the depth of your knowledge, quality of your training, and your ability to actually help someone create change.**



## 🔎 APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer these carefully in your OnlineJobs.ph application.



### 1. Imagine that a healthy person tells you:



**“There are certain things about myself that I want to change. I understand intellectually what I should do, but I repeatedly fall back into the same patterns.”**



How would you approach helping that person create lasting change?



Please explain your actual approach rather than simply listing techniques.



### 2. What are the deeper or less commonly known modalities you have studied or practiced?



Please tell me about approaches **beyond standard CBT or general talk therapy** that you believe can be useful for personal transformation.



There is **no requirement to know the specific modalities listed in this post**. I am interested in discovering what YOU know.



### BONUS QUESTION



What is your understanding of the relationship between the **amygdala, subconscious/implicit patterns, repeated experiences, neuroplasticity, and behavior change?**



If you are familiar with **Dr. Joe Dispenza or similar mind-body/consciousness approaches**, please explain your familiarity.



## 💰 PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RATE



Please include:



* Your **hourly or session rate**

* Normal session length

* Whether you offer an initial/trial session

* Price of the initial session, if different



**Please include your rate in your application.**



## 📱 ALTERNATIVE WHATSAPP CONTACT



The preferred method is to apply through **OnlineJobs.ph**.



However, if you believe you are an especially strong fit, you may also contact me directly on WhatsApp:



**WhatsApp: 
**



If contacting me through WhatsApp, please introduce yourself, explain your professional background and the approaches you specialize in, and include your rate.



## 💵 $20 REFERRAL BONUS



If you are **not personally the right person** for this position but know someone who would be an **excellent fit**, please feel free to share this post with them.



If your referral results in me hiring that person, **I will pay a $20 referral fee.**



So if you know an exceptional psychologist, therapist, coach, somatic practitioner, IFS practitioner, hypnotherapist, or another professional with deep expertise in personal transformation, please feel free to send them this opportunity.



## ⭐ FINAL



I am looking for someone with **real depth, broad knowledge, professionalism, and the ability to turn knowledge into action.**



Someone who can help me understand myself more deeply, introduce me to approaches I may not know about, create a personalized strategy for growth, and then **actually work with me to implement it.**



If you believe you are that person, I would be very interested in hearing from you.

description:
**Remote / Zoom | Part-Time / Sessions | Integrative & Experiential Approaches**



I am looking for an **experienced holistic wellness, mind-body, or therapeutic practitioner** who has broad knowledge of different approaches to emotional well-being, personal transformation, mind-body work, and deeper patterns of the mind.



I am specifically **NOT looking only for traditional talk therapy or CBT**.



I am interested in working with someone who understands approaches that go beyond simply discussing thoughts and can work with **emotions, the body, nervous system, subconscious patterns, internal parts, beliefs, and deeper experiential processes**.



## MODALITIES I AM INTERESTED IN



You do NOT need to practice every modality below. However, I am particularly interested in applicants with professional training or substantial experience in several of these areas:



* **Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work**

* **Somatic approaches / body-based work**

* **Mind-body approaches**

* **Inner-child work**

* Emotional processing

* Nervous-system regulation

* Breathwork

* Guided visualization

* Subconscious beliefs and patterns

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment-oriented approaches

* Emotional-release techniques

* Integrative or holistic psychology

* Hypnotherapy, where appropriately trained

* Yoga / yoga-based therapeutic practices

* Acupuncture / Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge

* Energy-oriented practices or energy healing

* Other legitimate holistic or complementary wellness modalities



I am also interested in practitioners familiar with ideas surrounding **meditation, consciousness, the mind-body connection, visualization, emotional states, and personal transformation**, including some of the themes discussed in the work of **Dr. Joe Dispenza and other mind-body/consciousness teachers**.



However, I am **not looking for someone who simply follows one teacher or repeats spiritual ideas**. I want someone with real training, experience, critical thinking, and a broad understanding of different modalities.



## WHAT I WANT TO LEARN AND EXPERIENCE



Part of my goal is educational.



I want someone who can help me understand:



**What different modalities exist? How do they work? What is each one designed to address? What happens during a session? How are they different from conventional talk therapy?**



Where appropriate to your qualifications and scope of practice, I would also like to **experience and practice different techniques through Zoom sessions**, rather than only hearing about them theoretically.



I am interested in discovering approaches that work with the person on multiple levels — **mind, emotions, body, internal patterns, habits, beliefs, awareness, and overall well-being.**



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person might be a:



* Holistic wellness practitioner

* Mind-body practitioner

* Integrative therapist or counselor

* IFS-informed/trained practitioner

* Somatic practitioner

* Trauma-informed practitioner

* Breathwork practitioner

* Meditation/mindfulness teacher

* Hypnotherapist

* Or someone professionally trained across several related modalities



You should be able to clearly distinguish **which modalities you are formally trained/certified/licensed in, which you have practical experience with, and which you are simply knowledgeable about.**



## IMPORTANT



I value open-mindedness, but I also value **professionalism and honesty**.



Please do not claim that a particular technique can cure a medical or psychological condition unless that claim is within your professional scope and supported appropriately.



If you are not a licensed therapist, psychologist, physician, acupuncturist, or other licensed healthcare professional, that is okay — just clearly state your actual qualifications and professional scope.



I am looking for someone who knows **what they know and what they do not know**.



## ZOOM SESSIONS



Sessions will primarily take place remotely through **Zoom**.



You should be comfortable:



* Teaching and explaining different modalities

* Guiding appropriate exercises remotely

* Giving personalized practices between sessions

* Discussing what we observed during an exercise

* Recommending which approaches may be worth exploring further

* Explaining when something should instead be handled by an appropriately licensed or in-person professional



If a modality genuinely requires in-person treatment — for example, acupuncture — I can work with an appropriate local professional. You can still help educate me about the modality and how it fits into the larger mind-body picture.

title: Phone Sales Dialler
description:
🎯



**TL;DR:** We need experienced **outbound dialers** to make **200–400 calls a day** to warm leads and prospects already in our pipeline, and book them onto sales calls with our closers. Remote. **$500/month base + 5% commission on every deal you book that closes.** Must have outbound dialling experience, **perfect English**, and serious work ethic. **Read this page, apply at the link below, and submit an in-depth Loom video on why we should hire you: 
/hiring-setter**







# Why this role exists



We have more warm leads than we can call. Every day people opt in, apply, watch our VSL, come to our events and message us on Instagram. On top of that, there are hundreds of prospects already in our pipeline who spoke to us once and never got followed up properly.



Every one of those people put their hand up. When nobody calls them back fast, the money goes cold.



That is a **who** problem, not a **how** problem. You are the who.



Your job is simple: **pick up the phone, get the right people talking, and put qualified prospects on a call with our closers.** Do it 200–400 times a day, every day, and you will make yourself and this company a lot of money.



# Who we are



**7 Figure Scaling Systems (7FSS)**, founded by **Charlie Johnson**.



Charlie built one of the biggest online fitness coaching businesses in the UK. He has worked with **17,000+ clients**, generated **$20M+ online** across his companies, and won the **ClickFunnels Two Comma Club X award** (presented by Russell Brunson on stage in Las Vegas) for a single funnel that did over $10M.



Now we take everything that built that business and install it into other coaches' businesses: lead flow, sales, delivery, systems, team. We turn chaos into control and control into predictable income.



# Who you'll be calling



Our prospects are **online fitness coaches, personal trainers and fitness business owners**, mainly in the **US**, plus the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia and the UAE. They are typically:



- **Starting out** (under $10K/month): good coach, no predictable lead flow, posting content and hoping

- **Stuck in the middle** ($10K–$50K/month): busy and burnt out, doing everything themselves, no systems and no sales team

- **Ready to scale** ($50K+/month): need the team, operating rhythm and infrastructure to reach $100K–$200K months



They are not cold. Every person on your list has **already shown interest**: they opted in, applied, watched our VSL, bought an event ticket, booked a call before, or spoke to a closer and didn't sign yet.



# What we sell



You don't sell on the phone. You **qualify and book**. But you need to know what's on the other side of the call so you book the right people:



- **7FSS (7 Figure Scaling Systems):** our flagship mentorship. Coaching, systems and support to scale a fitness coaching business: lead generation, sales, client delivery, team and operations. For coaches who are already making money and want to scale.

- **FPLS:** our programme for coaches at an earlier stage who need the foundations in place first (offer, niche, lead flow and sales).

- **Live events and masterminds:** e.g. the **Scaling Summit** in Dubai.



Programmes are **high-ticket, typically several thousand dollars**. That's why the person you book must have the **money, the motivation and the decision-making power**. Booking someone who can't afford it wastes a closer's time and earns you nothing.



# What you'll actually do



- **Dial 200–400 times a day** through our dialer and CRM

- Call **new warm leads within minutes** of them coming in. Speed to lead wins.

- Work through the **existing pipeline**: no-shows, people who didn't close, people who went quiet, old applicants

- Qualify every conversation: where their business is today, where they want it to be, what's stopping them, whether they can invest, and whether they make the decision

- **Book qualified prospects straight into our closers' calendars** and get them committed to showing up

- Follow up by call, SMS and voi
 until you get an answer. One attempt is not follow-up.

- Log **every** dial, outcome and note in the CRM the same day. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.

- Post your numbers at end of day



# Our tools



- **Close CRM:** sales pipeline and dialer. Your call lists, notes and outcomes live here.

- **GoHighLevel (GHL):** lead capture, SMS follow-up and booking links

- **Slack:** team communication, booking notifications and EOD reports

- **Zoom:** where our closers run sales calls



Already used Close or GHL? Good, tell us. If you haven't, you'll need to learn them fast.



# The scorecard (how we measure you)



We don't measure hours. We measure output. This is your weekly scorecard:



| Metric | Target |

| --- | --- |

| Dials per day | 200 minimum, 400 is the standard |

| Speed to lead (new warm leads) | Called within 5 minutes during your shift |

| Qualified calls booked | Set in your first 2 weeks, based on your connect rate. Then it goes up. |

| Show rate on the calls you book | Above the team average |

| Booked calls that are qualified (money + decision maker) | 90%+ |

| CRM logging (every dial, outcome and note) | 100%, same day |

| EOD report posted | Every working day |



If your scorecard is green, nobody chases you about how you work. If it's red, we'll talk about it straight away. No surprises either way.



# Must-haves (non-negotiable)



- **Proven outbound dialling experience.** You've done high-volume outbound before (setting, SDR, appointment setting, call centre) and you can show us your numbers. No experience, no interview.

- **Perfect English.** Spoken and written. Our prospects are mainly American and British business owners. You have to sound confident, natural and easy to understand on the first "hello".

- **Huge work ethic and tenacity.** 200–400 dials a day means a lot of no's, voi
s and hang-ups. You keep going on call 300 the same way you did on call 1.

- **Thick skin.** Rejection doesn't slow you down. It's part of the job.

- **Organised.** Clean CRM, notes that a closer can read in 10 seconds, follow-ups never missed.

- **Reliable.** You show up for every shift, on time. If something's wrong, you say so before it becomes a problem.

- **Set-up:** quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet, and availability during **US and UK calling hours**



# Nice-to-haves



- Experience with **Close** and/or **GoHighLevel**

- Experience setting for **high-ticket coaching, consulting or info offers**

- Understanding of the **fitness / online coaching** industry

- Experience with SMS and DM follow-up alongside calls



# Who this is NOT for



Be honest with yourself. You'll hate this role if:



- You think 200 dials is a lot. For us it's the minimum.

- You need someone to motivate you every morning

- You take "no" personally

- You want a guaranteed salary without having to perform. Most of the money in this role is commission.

- You're looking for a side gig to do around something else



# Who this IS for



- You love the phone and you're competitive about your numbers

- You want uncapped earnings tied directly to what you produce

- You want to work with a fast-growing team that gives more responsibility (and more money) to people who earn it

- You eventually want to move into closing. The best dialers learn the offer, the prospect and the objections better than anyone.



# How we work (our values)



- **Success loves speed.** Call fast, follow up fast.

- **Extreme ownership.** Your pipeline, your numbers, your result. No excuses, no blame.

- **Dependability.** Do what you said, when you said you'd do it.

- **Organised and prepared.** The CRM is always up to date.

- **Open and honest, even when it's painful.** Tell us what's working and what isn't. We'll do the same.



# Your first 30 days



- **Week 1:** Get set up in Close, GHL and Slack. Learn our offers, our prospects and the script. Listen to recorded sales calls. Start dialling.

- **Week 2:** Full volume: 200+ dials a day. Calls booked onto closers' calendars.

- **Weeks 3–4:** 300–400 dials a day, a consistent booking number, and a show rate above the team average

- **Day 30:** Hitting your scorecard every week



# Compensation



- **$500/month base**

- **5% commission on every deal you book that closes**

- Uncapped. The more qualified calls you book, the more you earn.



**Example (illustrative only, not a promise):** our programmes are high-ticket. If 8 of the calls you book in a month close at $5,000 each, that's $40,000 in sales → **$2,000 commission + $500 base = $2,500** for the month. Double the closed deals, double the commission.



Remote, long-term role. Top performers get more leads, more responsibility, and a route into closing.



# How to apply



1. **Read this whole page.** If it's not for you, no hard feelings.

2. **Watch the full hiring video** at **
/hiring-setter**

3. **Click "Apply Now"** and complete the application

4. **Record an in-depth Loom video and add the link to your application.** This is required. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed.



**What your Loom must cover (5–10 minutes, camera on):**



- **Why we should hire you** for this role, over everyone else applying

- **Your outbound experience:** where you've dialled, what you were selling, how long for

- **Your numbers:** dials per day, conversations, calls booked, show rate. Real numbers, not "a lot"

- **How you handle rejection** and how you stay sharp on dial 300 of the day

- **A short example of your opener**, exactly how you'd start a call with a warm lead who opted in yesterday

- **Why this role, and why now**



We want to hear how you speak, how you think and how hungry you are. Treat the Loom like your first call with us, because it is. Applications without numbers go to the bottom of the pile.

title: Content Producer & Short-Form Video Editor — Luxury Beauty + Personal Brand
description:
We’re looking for a high-taste Content Producer and Short-Form Video Editor to create content for two distinct brands:



• A premium permanent makeup and luxury beauty brand

• A founder-led personal brand focused on life, love, identity, confidence, self-worth and personal transformation



This is not simply a video-cutting position.



We need someone who understands:



• Pacing

• Hooks

• Visual storytelling

• Audience retention

• Music and sound selection

• Clean text placement

• Brand identity

• Emotional impact

• What makes people stop scrolling



You should be able to take an approved concept, creative brief and source material and turn them into polished, post-ready content without needing every cut, transition or design choice explained to you.



You will not be responsible for filming or posting content.



Your primary responsibility will be producing and editing high-quality content from footage, images, templates, scripts and creative direction provided by our team.



THE TWO BRANDS



LUXURY BEAUTY BRAND



The beauty brand specializes in premium permanent makeup services.



Its content may include:



• Client transformations

• Before-and-after results

• Permanent brows

• Lip Blush

• Permanent Eyeliner

• Beauty education

• Service storytelling

• Luxury beauty experiences

• Promotional campaigns

• Selected AI-assisted cinematic campaigns



This brand’s content should feel:



• Polished

• Premium

• Clean

• Modern

• Feminine

• Intentional

• Results-focused

• Visually elevated



FOUNDER-LED PERSONAL BRAND



The personal brand focuses on:



• Life

• Love

• Identity

• Self-worth

• Standards and boundaries

• Personal transformation

• Honest storytelling

• Feminine confidence



This brand should feel natural, emotionally engaging and conversational—not overly produced or like a generic influencer page.



The right candidate must understand how to edit these two brands differently without blending their identities.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will produce short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



Responsibilities may include:



• Reviewing creative briefs and source materials

• Selecting the strongest footage and moments

• Editing face-to-camera videos

• Editing beauty, service, lifestyle and transformation content

• Producing short story-driven videos

• Producing simple graphics and carousels using approved templates

• Creating strong openings and maintaining viewer attention

• Adding approved on-screen text, captions, music and sound effects

• Creating clean transitions and visual flow

• Repurposing strong source material into multiple useful assets when directed

• Using AI tools for selected creative and cinematic projects

• Organizing project files, source assets and final exports

• Following the assigned production queue and deadlines

• Reviewing your own work before submitting it

• Delivering complete, polished work rather than unfinished drafts



You will receive brand direction, creative briefs and priorities. You are expected to use independent editing judgment while remaining within the approved direction.



AI CONTENT EXPERIENCE



Not all content will be AI-generated.



Traditional editing, storytelling and content judgment are the foundation of this position.



However, familiarity with AI creative platforms is strongly preferred because selected campaigns will include AI-assisted imagery and cinematic video production.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



• Higgsfield

• ChatGPT

• Image-generation platforms

• AI video-generation platforms

• CapCut AI tools



If you have produced AI-assisted advertisements, cinematic videos, character-consistent scenes or story-based campaigns, please include examples.



SCHEDULE AND EXPECTED WORK



This is a 20-hour-per-week position:



• 4 hours per day

• 5 days per week

• Monday through Friday



Weekly assignments will vary according to brand priorities and the complexity of each project.



Assignments may include:



• Standard short-form edits

• Face-to-camera videos

• Before-and-after content

• Graphics or carousels

• Campaign assets

• AI-assisted cinematic content



There is no inflexible daily production quota.



A complex AI cinematic assignment may replace several standard edits. We care about strong, useful output—not rushed work created simply to meet a content count.



YOU’RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU:



• Have strong CapCut experience

• Have experience editing TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts

• Understand hooks, pacing and viewer retention

• Have strong visual taste and aesthetic judgment

• Can edit both polished brand content and natural personal storytelling

• Can follow creative direction without requiring constant supervision

• Can make thoughtful editing decisions independently

• Know when an edit needs energy and when it needs restraint

• Care about spelling, timing, text placement and small details

• Can organize files and meet deadlines

• Accept feedback professionally

• Learn from revisions and avoid repeating the same mistakes

• Can work efficiently without sacrificing quality

• Communicate clearly and raise questions before they become delays



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You require frame-by-frame instructions for every edit

• Your work frequently feels cluttered, chaotic or over-edited

• You use effects and transitions without a clear purpose

• You make every brand look like the same social media template

• You rely on trends without understanding the brand

• You submit unfinished work and expect the company to complete it

• You repeatedly miss details already included in the brief

• You need constant reminders to meet deadlines

• You cannot distinguish between luxury beauty content and authentic personal storytelling

• You depend entirely on AI and lack traditional editing skills



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong CapCut experience

• Short-form video editing experience

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing and retention

• Clean on-screen text and caption placement

• Strong visual storytelling ability

• Excellent attention to detail

• Dependable communication

• Ability to follow brand standards and creative briefs

• Reliable computer and internet connection

• Ability to work independently



PREFERRED SKILLS



• AI video or image-generation experience

• Higgsfield experience

• Beauty, lifestyle or luxury-brand experience

• Face-to-camera and personal-brand editing

• Story-driven or cinematic editing

• Canva experience

• Basic sound design

• Experience managing assignments in Asana or a similar project-management platform



COMPENSATION



• Starting rate: $5–$7 USD per hour

• Final starting rate will be based on demonstrated skill, portfolio quality and paid-trial performance

• 20 hours per week

• 90-day probationary period

• Performance reviews during the probationary period

• Opportunity for increased compensation, hours and responsibility based on demonstrated performance



The starting range will be applied as follows:



• $5/hour — developing candidate with strong potential who requires additional training or direction

• $6/hour — experienced candidate who produces strong traditional edits and requires limited direction

• $7/hour — advanced candidate who demonstrates excellent editing judgment, clear brand distinction, minimal revision needs and strong AI-production ability



Compensation growth will be based on:



• Quality of work

• Consistency

• Dependability

• Speed and efficiency

• Ability to follow direction

• Reduction in unnecessary revisions

• Independent judgment

• Ability to support both brands successfully

• Development and application of AI-production skills



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid trial assignment using our brand materials and direction.



The trial may include:



• One luxury beauty-brand edit

• One personal-brand edit

• A short AI-production exercise or review of your existing AI work



The purpose is to evaluate editing ability, creative judgment, attention to detail and your ability to distinguish between the two brands.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following:



A link to your three strongest short-form editing samples.



At least one face-to-camera or personal-storytelling sample.



At least one beauty, lifestyle, luxury or transformation-based sample.



Any AI-generated video, image or cinematic work you have created. If you do not have AI samples, state that honestly.



A list of the editing and AI tools you personally know how to use.



Your current availability and the hours you are available to work.



Your internet speed and computer specifications.



For every sample submitted, briefly explain what you personally handled.



Answer the following question in 4–6 sentences:



“How would you make the editing style feel different for a premium beauty-service brand versus an honest, personality-led storytelling brand?”



Begin your application with the words:



“I understand the difference.”



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a trusted, long-term creative team member—not someone searching for occasional editing work.

title: Senior Amazon PPC Specialist, Part-Time, Profit-Focused, Long-Term
description:
Position Details: 

• Hours: 15 to 20 hours per week, up to 25 in peak weeks (Prime events, Q4)

• Location: Remote, any location. Must be available 9am to 1pm US Eastern at least three days a week, plus live coverage on major sale events (Prime events, Black Friday, Cyber Monday)

• Rate: $12 to $20 per hour, based on experience

• Engagement: Long-term contract, reporting directly to company leadership



About the Role:

We are a US-based consumer products company selling across several Amazon marketplaces in North America, Europe and Australia. We manage advertising to profit, not to ACoS. Every SKU carries its own margin data, and a data pipeline produces a proposed change list each cycle. You own the judgment and execution on top of that pipeline: d
 what to approve, what to reject, and what the system missed. This is a senior seat for someone who has already run ads for multiple brands and wants a steady, long-term engagement.



What You Will Do:

• Run two change cycles per week across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display using bulk files and a system-generated change list

• Approve, reject or adjust proposed bid, budget and negative-targeting changes, with a short written reason for anything you change outside the proposed list

• Submit changes above a set dollar threshold for owner approval before they go live

• Own search-term harvesting, negative targeting, placement adjustments and new campaign builds

• Respond to daily pacing alerts: spend spikes, out-of-budget campaigns, low stock cover, zero-impression campaigns

• Review a weekly scorecard per account (spend, ad sales, total sales, profit after ads, TACoS, organic share) and write a short read of what changed and why

• Plan and pace event periods: Prime events, Black Friday and Cyber Monday



Requirements:

• 4+ years of hands-on Amazon Ads management across multiple brands or accounts

• Profit-based management, not ACoS alone: you can set targets from contribution margin and breakeven ACoS, reason about operating profit after ads and returns, and judge marginal ROAS on incremental spend. You can describe a time you cut spend because of it and profit went up

• Fluent with bulk sheets and large data exports (Excel or Google Sheets at a high level)

• Comfortable working inside an AI-assisted workflow: changes are proposed by a system, reviewed and edited by you, and approved above a dollar threshold by the owner

• Clear, concise written English

• Government-issued ID matching your contract name and payment account

• You do the work personally: no subcontracting, no shared accounts, time tracked under a single account



Nice to Have:

• Walmart Connect, Shopify or TikTok Shop ads experience

• Experience with Sellerise, Helium 10, Feedvisor or similar tools

• Jewelry, accessories, gifts or beauty categories



How to apply:

In your application, write two or three sentences about a time you reduced ad spend and profit went up. Include the numbers. Applications without this will not be reviewed.



Process:

1. Short application (see above)

2. One video interview with leadership

3. Paid test: $35 flat, about 90 minutes, working from an anonymized data export. Paid whether or not we move forward

4. Offer, contract and ID verification (government-issued ID matching your contract name and payment account)
